state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM oban_jobs WHERE state = 'scheduled'
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM oban_jobs WHERE state = 'retryable'
state_queries.dead: SELECT count(*) FROM oban_jobs WHERE state = 'discarded'
state_queries.running: SELECT count(*) FROM oban_jobs WHERE state = 'executing'

operator_notes: Haystack via Oban.insert_all with args {h,t}; Oban.Job.query (id, args @>, worker/state/queue) with Repo.one/all and Repo.aggregate on a separate 2-connection repo; Oban.pause_queue/resume_queue (broadcast, not persisted: a restarted node runs unpaused).
